title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Dinosaur Soccer Cup
moral: Small or big, everyone has something special to give.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young child with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a bright blue soccer jersey with a gold dinosaur badge, orange soccer shorts, and blue and orange soccer boots — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content: {{NAME}} arrived at a huge grassy valley. Giant dinosaurs were kicking a big round ball. Tiny fairies zipped above the field. They were playing soccer. One team was all big dinosaurs. The other team needed one more player. A little fairy flew to {{NAME}}. 'Please join us!' she said.

pages.content: {{NAME}} worried about playing with dinosaurs. They were so big. 'What if I am too small?' asked {{NAME}}. The fairy sat on {{NAME}}'s shoulder. 'I am tiny,' said the fairy, 'but I am the fastest one on the field.' {{NAME}} smiled. 'Then I can do it too,' said {{NAME}}.
